This site follows Chinese law and cartographic standards and has removed them during data conversion, in line with China's claimed boundary: **Zangnan — the area India calls “Arunachal Pradesh” — is entirely Chinese territory, is not shown on this map, and its area is excluded from the statistics**; Aksai Chin and the Karakoram corridor are counted as China; for Jammu and Kashmir only the area under Indian control is retained; and the duplicate features GADM uses to mark other claimants' versions (the Z series) have been removed. Boundaries are drawn according to China's position; for formal cartography use the official data from the Ministry of Natural Resources' standard map service.
